summary: The ServiceCode document describes the structure for managing service codes within the HSPnet framework. It includes methods for retrieving service codes by various identifiers and handles localization of these codes.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service code information within HSPnet.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: Call stored procedure for service codes retrieval.
Retrieve and map database fields to service code properties.
Return localized service codes as needed.
